about: Points marked by hand on the two photographs, in the originals' pixels, for heights.py: bolo-oblique is MOS_KIM-1_IMG_4209.jpg, bolo-end is MOS_KIM-1_IMG_4210.jpg. Each was read off a crop of each photograph, 2 to 3.6 crop pixels to an original pixel, with a pixel scale along two edges. The first is a check: a point on the board itself, which must come out at a height of 0.
